segments.he: הָתָם אֶפְשָׁר, הָכָא לָא אֶפְשָׁר, וְאִי לָא אָפֵיךְ אִיכָּא בִּזְיוֹן כִּתְבֵי הַקּוֹדֶשׁ טְפֵי.
segments.en: The Gemara answers: «There,» with regard to scribes, «it is possible» to cover the parchment respectfully; «here,» it «is not possible» to do so. «And if he does not turn» the scroll «over, it will be more degrading to the sacred writings.» Consequently, although this is not an ideal solution, it is preferable to turn it over rather than leave the scroll exposed.

moves.summary: answers the baraita objection: there covering is possible, here not
moves.about: distinguishes scribes, who can cover the sheet, from the reader, who cannot, so turning is the lesser disgrace

edges.about: distinguishes scribes, who can cover the sheet, from the reader, who cannot, so turning is the lesser disgrace

positions.claim: where covering is impossible, turning the scroll over is less degrading than leaving it exposed
